name: What accessibility features should multigenerational homes include?

mainEntity.name: What accessibility features should multigenerational homes include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wide doorways (36"), zero-step entries, lever handles, grab bar blocking in bathrooms, main-level bedrooms, and slip-resistant flooring support aging family members and mobility needs.
